title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Choose ten distinct study environments. Verify access rules, room or reservation constraints, and the physical affordance that makes each useful. Treat “Claimed by 9am” as editorial framing; never assert crowding or student behavior without evidence.

cards.entity_name: Benjamin S. Rosenthal Library Study Carrels
cards.title: Quiet Study Carrels
cards.subtitle: Levels 4 and 5 of Rosenthal Library
cards.notes: Utilize these personal carrels for focused, silent work. They are available on a first-come, first-served basis for students requiring a distraction-free environment.
cards.short_summary: Individual quiet study carrels located on the upper floors of the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: Rosenthal Library has personal carrels for quiet study use located on levels 4 and 5, available on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.source_title: Maps & Spaces | Benjamin S. Rosenthal Library - Queens College - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; requires a valid QCard for entry through turnstiles.

cards.title: Collaborative Study Hub
cards.subtitle: Kiely Hall, Rooms 131 and 144
cards.notes: Access technology-enabled spaces featuring iMacs, Windows PCs, and whiteboards. This area supports both collaborative group work and quiet individual study.
cards.short_summary: A tech-equipped study and tutoring center located in Kiely Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The QC Learning Commons in Kiely Hall 131/144 offers collaborative and quiet study space with iMacs, Windows PCs, and whiteboards.
cards.source_title: Queens College Learning Commons - Tutoring, Study Space - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Typically open Monday-Thursday 9am-5pm during active semesters.

cards.title: Music Building Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Music Building, Lower Level
cards.notes: Request access at the Music Library Circulation Desk for rooms 125a or 125c. These spaces are dedicated to group study for students with valid IDs.
cards.short_summary: Designated group study rooms located within the Aaron Copland School of Music.
cards.evidence_claim: The Music Library has two rooms on the Lower Level (125a and 125c) available for group study on a first-come, first-serve basis.
cards.source_title: Music Library Study Room Policies & Procedures - Queens College - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Available during Music Library hours; must present valid QC ID at the desk.

cards.title: Elevator-Adjacent Lounges
cards.subtitle: Powdermaker Hall, Floors 1-3
cards.notes: Find seating in the open lounge areas located directly across from the elevators on the first three floors. Ideal for quick study sessions between classes.
cards.short_summary: Convenient open-access study lounges on multiple floors of Powdermaker Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus lounges can be found in Powdermaker Hall on the first, second, and third floors, located across from elevators on each floor.
cards.source_title: Where can I go to study at the Queens College campus? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Open during general building hours; no reservation required.

cards.title: QCAP Study & Meeting Room
cards.subtitle: Powdermaker Hall, Room 251
cards.notes: Reserve this space for private Zoom meetings or group study sessions. The room often provides snacks and refreshments for students.
cards.short_summary: A reservable community space in Powdermaker Hall for academic needs.
cards.evidence_claim: The QCAP Space in Powdermaker Hall 251 can be reserved for private Zoom meetings or study space with friends.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 9:30 AM - 3 PM; reservations recommended.

cards.title: Main Lobby Study Area
cards.subtitle: Science Building, First Floor
cards.notes: Use the seating in the main lobby area for studying or attending online courses. This central spot is easily accessible from the campus quad.
cards.short_summary: A public study lounge located in the main entrance of the Science Building.
cards.evidence_claim: A campus lounge is located in the Science Building, first floor main lobby area, for studying or zooming into online courses.
cards.source_title: Where can I go to study at the Queens College campus? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; free for all students.

cards.title: First Year Experience Study Room
cards.subtitle: Honors Hall, Room 5
cards.notes: Drop by this designated space for solo or group study. It offers a quiet environment with ample tables and chairs for focused work.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, designated study room open to all students in Honors Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Honors Hall Room 5 is open to all students as a designated study space with plenty of seats and tables.
cards.source_title: Study Space - First Year Experience - Queens College - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Open to all students during office hours.

cards.title: The Dome Desks
cards.subtitle: Freestanding structure near Powdermaker Hall
cards.notes: Work at long tables equipped with swiveling, adjustable seating and power outlets. This unique architectural space is often used for quiet study.
cards.short_summary: A unique freestanding structure featuring long desks and power outlets for laptops.
cards.evidence_claim: Campbell Dome seats 88 at rows of long tables offering swiveling, adjustable seating and outlets for laptops.
cards.source_title: Classrooms and Lecture Halls | Queens College, CUNY
cards.access_notes: Access depends on scheduled events; typically open for student use when not in session.

cards.title: Corridor Study Nooks
cards.subtitle: Remsen Hall, Floors 1-3
cards.notes: Find quiet spots at the ends of the second and third-floor corridors or across from labs 151, 251, and 351. These areas are tucked away from main traffic.
cards.short_summary: Quiet study lounges located at the ends of hallways in Remsen Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Lounges in Remsen Hall are located on the first, second, and third floors across from labs and at the end of the 2nd and 3rd floor corridors.
cards.source_title: Where can I go to study at the Queens College campus? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Queens Hall Open Study
cards.subtitle: Queens Hall, Floors 1 and 2
cards.notes: Study in the open area to the left of the elevator on the second floor or in front of Room 135. These spots offer a change of pace from the main campus.
cards.short_summary: Open-access study areas located in Queens Hall, across from the library annex.
cards.evidence_claim: Queens Hall has study lounges on the first floor (in front of Room 135) and second floor (open area to the left of the elevator).
cards.source_title: Where can I go to study at the Queens College campus? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; located slightly off the main campus quad.
